name: 98087 · Lynnwood, WA
findings: ZIP 98087 (Lynnwood) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98087 (Lynnwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98087 (Lynnwood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
